name: Should I remove an old shower myself or hire a pro?
description: DIY can work for simple demo, but pros are safer when plumbing, tile, or hidden water damage is involved.

mainEntity.name: Should I remove an old shower myself or hire a pro?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes—DIY shower removal can save money, but it is riskier if the shower is tiled, tied into plumbing, or showing signs of water damage. A professional is usually the safer choice when you need disposal, waterproofing, or fast cleanup in an occupied home.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY can work for simple demo, but pros are safer when plumbing, tile, or hidden water damage is involved.
